fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off Garner Rd at the SE corner. Wide divided driveway with a landscaped median island, yellow lane channelization striping, and a guard booth set inside the apron (visible z21 satellite as a dark canopied structure).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small canopied guard booth structure inside the entrance lane, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, beside the divided in/out lanes - confirmed in z21 satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron and trailer staging area inside the gate before docks; the SE entrance opens onto an expansive yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep apron and internal yard easily holds 3+ trucks between the gate and dock doors.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and divided lanes with ample unused paved width - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point on Garner Rd serves both in and out via the divided driveway.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from divided-lane striping; satellite resolution limits exact count - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South face of the lower plant building shows a long bank of dock doors with branded Frito-Lay trailers backed in; additional dock bank on the east face. Total estimated 60+ across faces - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer-parking rows on the east side and along the south - well over 50 trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (south face and east face) indicating separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within Modesto metro industrial fabric, surrounded by other large DCs/warehouses.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Plant comprises multiple connected building masses plus a separate large warehouse building to the north (co-located Modesto Exchange Warehouse) - campus character.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in the truck path - low confidence, possible but not confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur entering the property; a rail/road corridor runs along the north boundary but no spur into the yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box yields ~81 acres, matching the publicly stated 80-acre / 500k sq ft facility.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Overhead count estimate; some dock faces partially obscured by trailers - moderate confidence.
